phases.objective: Bind the final Migration 1050 bytes to the immutable merge identity of this rollout PR after merge, retain PR #6629 as upstream repair lineage, preserve checksum/source authorization binding, redact raw authorization-bearing evidence at every depth, preserve only bounded readiness diagnostics, and when the capability envelope ledger itself is absent perform exactly one database-independent Hostinger-local full inspection in read-only mode so the governance foundation state can be classified without authorizing SQL, Migration 1049 retry, or live GitHub Ruleset mutation.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: After PR 6746 is merged, readiness derives its immutable merge SHA from GitHub, requires Production to contain that merge and exact Migration 1050 blob 06a2ddde04f6feafefae1cc1cef69dbc6fdadd3f, checksum-binds the decoded raw bytes, proves the durable authorization remains checksum/source-bound after Apply, and publishes only bounded non-sensitive evidence. If capability_resolution_envelope_ledger is absent, readiness additionally captures a bounded read-only Hostinger-local full-inspection projection for runtime, governance, and runtime_persistence while leaving the original authorization failure intact; Migration 1049 retry and live GitHub Ruleset Apply remain prohibited.
steps: Resolve upstream repair PR 6629 and require merge 5505adde1bf29125c56d8588cf8de3ee956c819c as immutable lineage.
Resolve rollout PR 6746 only after it is merged, derive its immutable merge SHA, and require that merge to contain the upstream repair lineage.
Require current Production to contain the rollout merge and exact Migration 1050 Git blob before readiness can proceed.
Decode GitHub Contents base64 to raw bytes, reproduce the Git blob SHA, compute SHA-256 directly over those bytes, and require exactly seven SQL statements.
Prove Runtime version and deployment-info converge to the exact stable Production SHA.

During readiness only, observe failed admin-control responses without retrying them and persist at most bounded transport status, exit code, parseable child error code, and non-sensitive failure classification while excluding raw stdout, raw stderr, error messages, request bodies, and headers.

Only when the child error is ER_NO_SUCH_TABLE and the parsed child payload identifies capability_resolution_envelope_ledger as missing, resolve the exact current Production SHA and issue one POST /admin/runtime-bootstrap/runs request for database.inspect / database.full_inspection / dry_run against host_local_role_env and production-runtime.

Persist only the bounded full-inspection projection: selected role names, role object classifications, role object counts, role object-count fingerprints, target fingerprint, safe response code, and explicit no-mutation flags; never persist credentials, database names, raw response text, request/response headers, or error messages.
Keep the original readiness request result unchanged so a missing governance foundation still fails closed instead of being converted into authorization success.
Create checksum-bound migration authorization, execute dry-run only, and verify one durable authorization row during readiness when the governance foundation exists.
Require a distinct Migration 1050 Apply command, same-cycle dry-run, an apply-authorized migration capability envelope, and exactly one Apply transport invocation.
Preserve authorization metadata when the migration seed UPSERT executes and re-read checksum, statement count, source PR, and source merge after Apply.

Publish that bounded durable binding under migration_binding_summary while keeping every raw or nested authorization, token, secret, cookie, API key, credential, or private key field subject to recursive evidence redaction.
Never retry after ambiguous Apply transport; reconcile through exact migration ledger plus durable authorization and metadata readback.
Verify the five canonical repository-policy registration surfaces plus authorization metadata and keep live GitHub policy apply false.
assertions: The producer has contents: read only, persist-credentials=false, and cannot mutate Issues.
The rollout workflow cannot run from PR code before PR 6746 is merged into the trusted default branch.
Production missing the rollout merge or exact blob fails closed before authorization or dry-run.
SHA-256 is computed from decoded raw GitHub bytes and those bytes must reproduce the pinned Git blob SHA.
Migration 1049 is never invoked or retried by this lifecycle.
Readiness performs no migration Apply.
The readiness authorization-envelope decision note remains canonical and shell-safe under capability alias validation, and the global shell metacharacter guard is not weakened.

The readiness diagnostic wrapper performs exactly one underlying fetch for each original governed request, never retries that request, and cannot change the original response returned to the rollout runner.

The Hostinger-local foundation inspection is triggered only by the exact ER_NO_SUCH_TABLE plus capability_resolution_envelope_ledger condition, is bound to the live Production SHA, and uses database.inspect, database.full_inspection, dry_run, host_local_role_env, and production-runtime with no migration selector.

A successful foundation inspection is accepted only when database_mutation_performed, migration_apply_performed, grant_mutation_performed, and workflow_dispatch_performed are all explicitly false; otherwise its receipt is rejected as unsafe diagnostic evidence.

Readiness failure and foundation-inspection evidence exclude raw stdout, raw stderr, error messages, request bodies, response headers, request headers, credential values, database identifiers, and secrets.
The foundation inspection does not satisfy or replace the missing capability envelope ledger; readiness remains failed until the separately governed governance foundation is repaired.
Apply and Verify continue to execute the canonical rollout runner directly and do not use the readiness diagnostic wrapper.
Apply contains exactly one governed_migration_execute Apply transport call and records apply_retried=false.
The Migration 1050 authorization seed merges into existing metadata instead of replacing checksum/source binding fields.
Post-Apply and standalone verification re-read and assert migration_checksum_sha256, expected_statement_count, pull_request, and merge_sha.
The exact key authorization is never globally allowlisted by the evidence sanitizer, so nested headers.authorization and equivalent secret-bearing fields are redacted.
Safe checksum/source binding evidence is exposed only through the non-sensitive migration_binding_summary key.
The migration-specific confirmation is distinct from APPLY_GITHUB_MAIN_REVIEW_POLICY.

No provider mutation, live GitHub Ruleset mutation, Production ref mutation, force push, credential payload publication, external business write, database mutation, migration Apply, or grant mutation is introduced by the readiness diagnostic fallback.
